text:
BMO Field hyɛɛ aseɛ 29 March 2006 na ɛdaa 28 April 2007, wɔyɛɛ no sɛ soccer-specific stadium ma 2007 FIFA U-20 World Cup ne Toronto FC fie a edi kan. Ne construction cost a edi kan yɛ CA$62.9 million, na Brisbin Brooks Beynon Architects na ɛyɛɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no.

Beaeɛ no wɔ FieldTurf wɔ 2007 kɔsi 2009, na players kasa tiaa playing surface no. Wɔsesaa no yɛɛ natural Kentucky bluegrass ansa na 2010 season reba, na afei wɔde hybrid-grass system baeɛ wɔ 2019.

Nsesaeɛ kɛseɛ a Gensler yɛɛ no dii akyi wɔ 2014–2016, na ɛyɛɛ bɛyɛ CA$120 million. Ɛde east-grandstand upper deck a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ 8,400 seats baeɛ, wɔwieeɛ wɔ May 2015, ɛne canopy roof wɔ east, west ne south stands so na field a wɔatwa mu ama Canadian football. Saa adwuma yi nyinaa ma soccer capacity firi bɛyɛ 21,566 kɔ bɛyɛ 30,000.

Stadium no din trɛɛ soccer akyi bere a CFL Toronto Argonauts baa hɔ wɔ 2016 season mu. Ne configuration a ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛwɔ 28,180 seats, beaeɛ no daa so yɛ finals ne showcase fixtures, na ɛda ne gyinabea sɛ ɔman football fie.

Bank of Montreal wɔ naming rights sɛ BMO Field, nanso wɔsan too beaeɛ no Toronto Stadium ma 2026 World Cup wɔ FIFA clean-venue policy ase – sɛdeɛ wɔtoo no National Soccer Stadium ma 2007 ne 2014 FIFA youth tournaments no. 2026 World Cup no, ɛbɛhwɛ matches nsia: group-stage games anum ne Round of 32 fixture biako wɔ 2 July 2026, a ɛka Canada opener a ɛwɔ 12 June 2026 ho. Ne tournament capacity yɛ 43,036.
